requirements.quote:
*  PADDING, PING, and CRYPTO frames MAY appear in any packet number
      space.
requirements.condition: When a packet contains a PADDING, PING, or CRYPTO frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the frame to appear in any packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet parsing or generation can identify the frame type and packet number space and verify that no number-space restriction is imposed on these frame types.

requirements.quote:
*  CONNECTION_CLOSE frames signaling errors at the QUIC layer (type
      0x1c) MAY appear in any packet number space.  CONNECTION_CLOSE
      frames signaling application errors (type 0x1d) MUST only appear
      in the application data packet number space.
requirements.condition: When a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame has type 0x1c and signals a QUIC-layer error.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the frame to appear in any packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame type and enclosing packet number space are observable and can be tested across all packet number spaces.

requirements.quote:
*  CONNECTION_CLOSE frames signaling errors at the QUIC layer (type
      0x1c) MAY appear in any packet number space.  CONNECTION_CLOSE
      frames signaling application errors (type 0x1d) MUST only appear
      in the application data packet number space.
requirements.condition: When a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame has type 0x1d and signals an application error.
requirements.required_behavior: Send or accept the frame only in the application data packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send or accept the frame in any non-application-data packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation can inspect the CONNECTION_CLOSE type and verify the enclosing packet belongs to the application data packet number space.

requirements.quote:
*  ACK frames MAY appear in any packet number space but can only
      acknowledge packets that appeared in that packet number space.
      However, as noted below, 0-RTT packets cannot contain ACK frames.
requirements.condition: When an ACK frame appears in a packet number space other than a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the ACK frame to appear in that packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame type and packet number space can be observed when parsing or constructing a packet.

requirements.quote:
*  ACK frames MAY appear in any packet number space but can only
      acknowledge packets that appeared in that packet number space.
      However, as noted below, 0-RTT packets cannot contain ACK frames.
requirements.condition: When an ACK frame acknowledges packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Acknowledge only packets that appeared in the same packet number space as the ACK frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use an ACK frame to acknowledge a packet from a different packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: ACK ranges can be correlated with sent packet records and their packet number spaces to detect cross-space acknowledgments.

requirements.quote:
*  ACK frames MAY appear in any packet number space but can only
      acknowledge packets that appeared in that packet number space.
      However, as noted below, 0-RTT packets cannot contain ACK frames.
requirements.condition: When constructing or processing a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The 0-RTT packet must not contain an ACK frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet parser or generator can identify a 0-RTT packet and test whether an ACK frame is present.

requirements.quote:
*  All other frame types MUST only be sent in the application data
      packet number space.
requirements.condition: When sending any frame type other than PADDING, PING, CRYPTO, CONNECTION_CLOSE, or ACK.
requirements.required_behavior: Send the frame only in the application data packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send the frame in Initial or Handshake packet number spaces.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation can classify the frame type and verify the packet number space selected for transmission.

requirements.quote:
Note that it is not possible to send the following frames in 0-RTT
   packets for various reasons: ACK, CRYPTO, HANDSHAKE_DONE, NEW_TOKEN,
   PATH_RESPONSE, and RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID.  A server MAY treat receipt
   of these frames in 0-RTT packets as a connection error of type
   PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.condition: When constructing or processing a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The packet must not contain ACK, CRYPTO, HANDSHAKE_DONE, NEW_TOKEN, PATH_RESPONSE, or RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet type and contained frame types are directly observable, allowing each prohibited frame to be detected in a 0-RTT packet.

requirements.quote:
Note that it is not possible to send the following frames in 0-RTT
   packets for various reasons: ACK, CRYPTO, HANDSHAKE_DONE, NEW_TOKEN,
   PATH_RESPONSE, and RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID.  A server MAY treat receipt
   of these frames in 0-RTT packets as a connection error of type
   PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.condition: When a server receives an ACK, CRYPTO, HANDSHAKE_DONE, NEW_TOKEN, PATH_RESPONSE, or RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame in a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.error_behavior: The server may treat receipt as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject each listed frame in a 0-RTT packet and observe whether the server reports a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION connection error.
